relationships.subject: AnmTX Sco 9a-1
relationships.evidence_quote: animals treated by 1 mg/kg dose of Diclofenac or AnmTX Sco 9a-1 retained TNF-α level in blood same to intact animals

relationships.subject: AnmTX Sco 9a-1
relationships.evidence_quote: The peptide demonstrated a stable anti-inflammatory effect at doses of 1 and 0.1 mg/kg manifested in the paw volume decrease throughout the entire observation period

relationships.subject: AnmTX Sco 9a-1
relationships.evidence_quote: the peptide demonstrated no effect on rASIC1a or rASIC3 currents

key_findings: Novel sea anemone peptide AnmTX Sco 9a-1 reduced carrageenan edema, TNF-alpha and thermal hyperalgesia in mice
Its activity was not mediated by ASIC1a/ASIC3
